messages.text: Im dostupnom kursnom materijalu ne nalazim direktno relevantne informacije o asimetričnom šifrovanju. U pronađenom materijalu se govori o SIEM rješenjima, prikupljanju i analizi sigurnosnih događaja, kao i generiranju izvještaja. Želiš li postaviti pitanje u drugoj oblasti ili precizirati svoje pitanje?

Asymmetric encryption, also known as public-private key encryption, uses two different keys for encryption and decryption. The public key is used for encryption, while the private key is used for decryption. Common methods of asymmetric encryption include RSA, Elgamal, and Elliptic Curve Cryptography. This approach allows secure communication, as the public key can be shared openly, while the private key remains confidential.
